ازدجرا (form VIII)
# اِزْدَجَرَا (izdajarā) /iz.da.d͡ʒa.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
# اُزْدُجِرَا (uzdujirā) /uz.du.d͡ʒi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
# اِزْدَجِرَا (izdajirā) /iz.da.d͡ʒi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
